arxiv-2109-08474.title: The blazar OJ 287 jet from parsec- to kiloparsec-scales
arxiv-2109-08474.creator: Marina S. Butuzova
arxiv-2109-08474.description: Abstract The curved shape of the kiloparsec-scale jet of the blazar OJ 287 is analyzed in the framework of the precession of the central engine, on the existence on which a large number of studies over the past decades are based.

arxiv-2110-03451.title: An Energy Management System Approach for Power System Cyber-Physical Resilience
arxiv-2110-03451.creator: Katherine R. Davis
arxiv-2110-03451.description: Abstract Power systems are large scale cyber-physical critical infrastructure that form the basis of modern society. The reliability and resilience of the grid is dependent on the correct functioning of related subsystems, including computing, communications, and control. The integration is widespread and has a profound impact on the operation, reliability, and efficiency of the grid.

arxiv-2112-15432.title: Reconstruction of DBI-essence dark energy with f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity and its effect on black hole and wormhole mass accretion
arxiv-2112-15432.creator: Alokananda Kar, Shouvik Sadhukhan, Ujjal Debnath
arxiv-2112-15432.description: Abstract In this paper, we have used the reconstructed DBI-essence dark energy density to modify the mass accretions of black holes and wormholes. In general, the black hole mass accretion does not depend on the metric or local Einstein geometry.

arxiv-2309-16088.title: Reduction of a biochemical network mathematical model by means of approximating activators and inhibitors as perfect inverse relationships.
arxiv-2309-16088.creator: Chathranee Jayathilaka, Robyn Araujo, Lan Nguyen, Mark Flegg
arxiv-2309-16088.description: Abstract Models of biochemical networks are usually presented as connected graphs where vertices indicate proteins and edges are drawn to indicate activation or inhibition relationships. These diagrams are useful for drawing qualitative conclusions from the identification of topological features, for example positive and negative feedback loops.

arxiv-2502-04833.title: Puzzling Ultra-Diffuse Galaxy Evolution (PUDGE) Thanks: The project’s playful acronym refers to a character from the video game Dota 2, known for his large size.
arxiv-2502-04833.creator: Nataša Pavlov, Ana Mitrašinović
arxiv-2502-04833.description: Abstract The recent discovery of the most extended ultra-diffuse galaxy (UDG), Nube, has raised yet another question about the validity of the cold dark matter (CDM) model. The studies using cosmological and zoom-in simulations, which assume CDM, failed to replicate galaxies with the structural properties of Nube.

arxiv-2503-23127.title: Galaxy Imaging with Generative Models: Insights from a Two-Models Framework 2025 Galaxy Imaging with Generative Models: Insights from a Two-Models Framework – References
arxiv-2503-23127.creator: Jean-Eric Campagne
arxiv-2503-23127.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jean-Eric Campagne. Generative models have recently revolutionized image generation tasks across diverse domains, including galaxy image synthesis. This study investigates the statistical learning and consistency of three generative models: light-weight-gan (a GAN-based model), Glow (a Normalizing Flow-based model), and a diffusion model based on a U-Net denoiser, all trained on non-overlapping subsets of the SDSS dataset of 64 × 64 64\times 64 grayscale images.

arxiv-2512-18808.creator: Emmanuel Opshtein
arxiv-2512-18808.description: Abstract . In [ OS24 ] we proved that the contact sphere S 3 S^{3} has Legendrian barriers, that intersect any sufficiently long embedded Reeb cylinders over Legendrian knots. We generalize here this result to contact prequantization bundles. 1. pmc-10690608.creator: Elis Susilawati, Jutti Levita, Yasmiwar Susilawati, Sri Adi Sumiwi
pmc-10690608.description: The concept of using plants to alleviate diseases is always challenging. In West Java, Indonesia, a local plant, named dadap serep has been traditionally used to reduce blood glucose, fever, and edema, by pounding the leaves and applying them on the inflamed skin, or boiled and consumed as herbal tea.

pmc-11328487.title: Comparative evaluation of the accuracy of electronic apex locators and cone-beam computed tomography in detection of root canal perforation and working length during endodontic retreatment
pmc-11328487.creator: Simay Koç, Hatice Harorlı, Alper Kuştarcı
pmc-11328487.description: BackgroundTo evaluate the accuracy of the electronic apex locators (EALs), and Cone-Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) scanning, both in working length (WL) determination and in the detection of root canal perforations in retreatment cases.MethodsSixty human mandibular premolars were selected. After crown removal partially and canal access, root canals were instrumented and irrigated.

pmc-11460037.title: Nanobiotechnology boosts ferroptosis: opportunities and challenges
pmc-11460037.creator: Shiqi Han, Jianhua Zou, Fan Xiao, Jing Xian, Ziwei Liu, Meng Li, Wei Luo, Chan Feng, Na Kong
pmc-11460037.description: Ferroptosis, distinct from apoptosis, necrosis, and autophagy, is a unique type of cell death driven by iron-dependent phospholipid peroxidation. Since ferroptosis was defined in 2012, it has received widespread attention from researchers worldwide. From a biochemical perspective, the regulation of ferroptosis is strongly associated with cellular metabolism, primarily including iron metabolism, lipid metabolism, and redox metabolism.

pmc-11672609.title: PA-Win2: In Silico-Based Discovery of a Novel Peptide with Dual Antibacterial and Anti-Biofilm Activity
pmc-11672609.creator: Jin Wook Oh, Min Kyoung Shin, Hye-Ran Park, Sejun Kim, Byungjo Lee, Jung Sun Yoo, Won-Jae Chi, Jung-Suk Sung
pmc-11672609.description: Background: The emergence and prevalence of antibiotic-resistant bacteria (ARBs) have become a serious global threat, as the morbidity and mortality associated with ARB infections are continuously rising. The activation of quorum sensing (QS) genes can promote biofilm formation, which contributes to the acquisition of drug resistance and increases virulence.

pmc-11716297.title: Plasma GFAP and pTau‐181 Moderate the Relationship between Cognition and White Matter Hyperintensities in a Southeast Asian Non‐Demented‐at‐Risk Cohort
pmc-11716297.creator: Gurveen Kaur Sandhu, Ashwati Vipin, Fatin Zahra Zailan, Pricilia Tanoto, Faith Phemie Hui En Lee, See Ann Soo, Smriti Ghildiyal, Shan Yao Liew, Isabelle Yu Zhen Tan, Yi Jin Leow, Dilip Kumar, Mohammed Adnan Azam, Wayne Freeman Chong, Nagaendran Kandiah
pmc-11716297.description: BackgroundAstrocyte reactivity marked by elevations in Glial Fibrillary Acidic Protein(GFAP), was found to increase Phosphorylated Tau181(pTau181) induced neurodegenerative effects in Alzheimer’s Disease (Bellaver et al., 2023). Nevertheless, the effect of the GFAP‐ pTau181 axis in vascular/mixed dementias has yet to be completely elucidated.

pmc-11863010.title: Use of vortioxetine in treating obsessive-compulsive disorder: a case report
pmc-11863010.creator: B. Jiménez-Fernández, N. V. Motta-Rojas, X. Iborra-Vicheto, J. Cuevas-Esteban
pmc-11863010.description: Introduction Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) is a chronic disorder with a wide range of manifestations but primarily intrusive thoughts (obsessions) and/or ritualized actions (compulsions) that can cause a huge distress in patients’ life. First-line treatment for OCD are selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs). Tricyclic antidepressants are used as second-line treatment due to secondary effects.

pmc-12471201.title: Comparative Analysis of the Effects of Acidic and Alkaline Beverages on the Optical Properties, Surface Topography, and Bacterial Activity of Zirconia Materials
pmc-12471201.creator: Nasser M. Alahmari
pmc-12471201.description: This study aimed to evaluate how acidic and alkaline staining solutions affect the optical properties (mean color change, ΔE*), geometric characteristics (surface roughness, Ra), and bacterial adhesion of zirconia Ceramill Zolid PS computer-aided design/computer-aided manufacture (CAD/CAM) material after 21 days of immersion.

pmc-12501793.title: The two coiled-coil domains of the fission yeast kinesin-6 Klp9 are required for motor tetramerization and spindle elongation
pmc-12501793.creator: Mason T Nguyen, Liang Ji, Phong T Tran
pmc-12501793.description: The fission yeast kinesin-6 Klp9 localizes to the spindle midzone at anaphase to produce sliding forces to elongate the bipolar spindle. In the absence of Klp9 , anaphase spindle elongation is attenuated by half its normal rate. Klp9 functions as a microtubule plus end-directed tetrameric motor.

pmc-12526426.title: A Grape-Derived Solvent for the Recovery of Phenolic Compounds from Food Waste By-Products Using Ultrasonic-Assisted and Overnight Extraction
pmc-12526426.creator: Dimitrios G. Lazaridis, Vassilios K. Karabagias, Nikolaos D. Andritsos, Aris E. Giannakas, Ioannis K. Karabagias
pmc-12526426.description: This present study aimed to investigate the recovery of polyphenols from red onion peel (OPP) and pomace of Merlot (MWP) and Syrah (SWP) grape varieties, using a common biphasic solvent (70/30 ethanol/water) and a new biphasic and eco-friendly solvent that has been developed in our laboratory (ethanol of grape origin).

pmc-12579923.title: The Equilibrium Conundrum
pmc-12579923.creator: Tess N Grainger, Keila Stark, Chuliang Song, Matthew A Barbour, Rachel M Germain
pmc-12579923.description: The idea that natural systems tend to be at equilibrium dates back to the origin of the field of ecology and continues to underlie most ecological theory. However, empirical evidence for equilibrium dynamics in nature and in experiments is surprisingly elusive.

pmc-12619689.title: Pseudoaneurysm of the Cystic Artery: A Unique Presentation of a Ruptured Gallbladder
pmc-12619689.creator: Hamdan Mallick, Jerome Lee, Mridul Pansari, Thomas Barnett
pmc-12619689.description: This case report details the atypical presentation and management of a 65-year-old male with a medical history encompassing hypertension, hepatitis C, and alcohol abuse (Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) score: 6). The patient presented to the emergency department with chest and lower abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting.

pmc-12781759.title: Prognostic impact of Fusobacterium nucleatum in head and neck cancers: a meta-analysis of critical oncological outcomes
pmc-12781759.creator: Asuman Feda Bayrak, Mehmet Emin Arayici, Ozden Savas, Erdogan Ozgur, Aydan Ozkutuk, Enis Alpin Guneri
pmc-12781759.description: BackgroundIt's a well-established fact that Fusobacterium nucleatum has been implicated in the pathogenesis and prognosis of several malignancies, but its role in head and neck cancers remains unclear. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to synthesize the evidence on the prognostic impact of Fusobacterium abundance in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC).

pmc-12954913.title: Setting a research agenda for the use of extended reality in healthcare simulation: an Utstein style meeting
pmc-12954913.creator: Barry Issenberg, Doris Ostergaard, Francisco Matos, Pier Luigi Ingrassia, Kirsty Freeman, Lars Konge, Carla Sa-Couto, Gabriel Reedy, The Utstein XR in Simulation Expert Group

BackgroundExtended reality (XR), encompassing virtual, augmented, and mixed reality, is increasingly integrated into healthcare simulation-based education and training. While XR offers immersive, scalable, and potentially cost-effective learning environments, evidence of its educational effectiveness and implementation remains fragmented.

pmc-13473303.title: Comparative genomic and functional analysis of Staphylococcus caprae clinical isolates: insights into genetic diversity and opportunistic pathogenic potential
pmc-13473303.creator: Yu-Hee Kim, Junghun Park, Ha Young Yun, Bomi Yoon, Minkyung Shin, Hae-Sun Chung, Jae Hyang Lim, Hee Jung Choi
pmc-13473303.description: Staphylococcus caprae, a coagulase-negative staphylococcus (CoNS), is an opportunistic microorganism increasingly identified in clinical specimens. However, its genomic and functional characterization in human infection have not yet been fully elucidated. In this study, we characterized the genomic and phenotypic diversity of two clinical S. caprae isolates, M89 and S13, to elucidate their opportunistic traits.

uslaw-usc-t15-s1666g.title: 15 U.S.C. § 1666g — Tie-in services prohibited for issuance of credit card
uslaw-usc-t15-s1666g.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s1666g.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 41 (Consumer Credit Protection); Subchapter I (Consumer Credit Cost Disclosure); Part D (Credit Billing). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Notwithstanding any agreement to the contrary, a card issuer may not require a seller, as a condition to participating in a credit card plan, to open an account with or procure any other service.
